EC1: Subjects [NOT] not able to give informed consent
EC3: Thrombolytic therapy within 24 hours before randomization
EC4: Oral anticoagulation with International Normalized Ratio (INR) > 2
EC5: Known platelets [OR] < 100.000/µl [OR] or known hemorrhagic diathesis
EC6: Stroke [OR] or Transient Ischemic Attack (TIA) [OR] within the past 6 months or any permanent residual neurological defect
EC7: Evidence of an active gastrointestinal [OR] or urogenital bleeding
EC9: History [AND] of allergic reaction to abciximab [OR] or eptifibatide [OR] or any component used in the study [OR] (including contrast media)
EC10: Known severe renal [OR] (creatinine clearance <30ml/min) or hepatic insufficiency [OR] as well as Alanine transaminase (ALT)/aspartate transaminase (AST) elevations = 3xUpper limit normal (ULN); isolated AST-elevation is not considered an exclusion criteria from study participation
EC11: Severe [AND] concomitant disease with life expectation [OR] < 1 year
EC12: Subject has participated in any study using an investigational drug [OR] or device within 30 days or within 5 half-lives of the investigational drug [OR] (whichever is longer) of entry into this study.
EC13: Subjects who will be inaccessible due to geographic or social factors during treatment or follow-up
EC14: In France, a subject is neither affiliated with nor a beneficiary of a social security category.
